description: Narrow current-worktree correction, preserving prior changes. Tests first in routing and merge owner suites: scope insert/update, loaded identity/grant preservation, invalid and uniqueness errors with rollback, validation-only no writes. Implement first struct upsert clause via change_rule and Repo.insert_or_update; scope delegates; remove update_rule; merger explicitly checks valid? without persistence. Existing named unique constraints audited against migration and match. Update only stale API docs. Real DB tests, no mocks; focused and concurrency tests, mix format, mix q, diff check and targeted coverage. No commit/push/PR. Single concern owned by routing context and existing merger caller.
title: Consolidate loaded routing writes and read-only merge validation
